calib_run_id.description: Unique, stable ID for this calibration run (e.g. C50). Never reuse after retiring a run.

tdm_ref.description: Git tag, branch, or commit SHA in the TDM submodule this calibration run runs against.

baseline_control_center.description: Filename of the default Control Center template in the TDM's Scenarios/_default/ library this run diffs against.

input_files.description: Input file paths for this run, relative to the calibration_runs/ directory. Resolved to absolute paths by the framework before writing the Control Center -- keeps this file machine-independent.

control_center_overrides.description: Control Center key/value overrides for this calibration run, applied to a per-run copy of the baseline_control_center template.

general_parameter_overrides.description: GeneralParameters.block (tdm/1_Inputs/0_GlobalData/, config/framework.yaml's general_parameters_path) key/value overrides for this calibration run. A separate mechanism from control_center_overrides: GeneralParameters.block is shared by every calibration run's working folder rather than templated per run, so these are applied via an extra READ FILE the framework inserts into the staged driver script, not by editing a per-run copy of the file itself -- see src/tdmcalib/general_parameters.py.

variables.description: Documentation-only parameters (e.g. a custom driver/step script's inputs) that are not Control Center keys and are not applied by the framework.

driver_script.description: Path to the driver script to stage for this run. Required -- always resolved explicitly, never silently defaulted. Resolved first relative to the calibration_runs/ directory (a fully custom file, e.g. 'hail-mary/__HailMary_1Subfolder_c50.s' -- companion/modified step scripts are NOT auto-staged and stay in place, referenced from this file by a relative path back to their location; must reference default TDM step scripts as '..\..\..\2_ModelScripts\...', three levels up, matching the working folder's depth). If no such file exists, resolved instead as a bare filename against the TDM's own Scenarios/_default/ library (e.g. '__HailMary.s' or '__HailMary_resumable.s' -- same two-levels-up path convention, no rewriting needed).

start_at_label.description: STEPn or STEPn_nn label to start execution from. Required -- every calibration run declares explicitly where it starts, so a resumed run is never mistaken for a fresh one (or vice versa). 'STEP0' means a normal full run from the beginning and is the default for all new calibration runs; no rewrite is performed against the staged driver script in that case. Any other value (matching a driver_script resumable variant's own labels, e.g. STEP4_12) skips everything before it, and is only valid alongside a driver_script that contains a 'RESUME POINT' GOTO marker -- its target is rewritten to this label in the staged copy at run time (the source file itself, and tdm/, are never modified). Relies on the raw working folder not being wiped between run attempts (see CLAUDE.md) -- whatever an earlier crashed attempt already wrote is still there for the resumed steps to pick up. Set back to 'STEP0' once no longer resuming, so the next run starts fresh.

start_from_copy.description: calib_run_id of another calibration run whose most recent successful run's raw working folder should be copied (in full) into this run's folder before execution -- lets a run whose change only affects a later model step skip recomputing everything upstream. Resolved via that run's run_metadata.json, skipping past any newer failed attempts to find the most recent success. Only used by `run`/`run-all` -- has no effect on manual execution.

lock_down_copy.description: When true, suppresses the start_from_copy copy for this run, leaving its raw working folder untouched by seeding -- use once the folder already holds the seeded state it needs. Has no effect unless start_from_copy is also declared.

prep_script.description: Path to a Python prep script, relative to the calibration_runs/ directory. Run once before model execution. Receives --calib-run-dir and --calib-run-id as arguments.

report_snapshot_script.description: Reserved for a future retirement/snapshot mechanism (not implemented by this version of tdmcalib). Path to a Python script, relative to the calibration_runs/ directory.

datafile.description: Glob pattern, evaluated against each output file's path relative to the run's working folder.

columns.description: Column names (matched against the CSV's header row) to keep. The matched file is written as a column-filtered copy named '<stem>_filtered.csv' instead of a byte-for-byte copy. Omit to copy the matched file(s) byte-for-byte.

matrix.description: Glob pattern matching a matrix file -- Cube's native .mtx by default (see source_format), or an already-OMX file.

tabs.description: Table/core names to extract from the matched matrix file.

source_format.description: Format of the matched source file. 'mtx' (default) is Cube's native TPP format and requires Voyager to be available at curation time (config/local.yaml's Voyager_EXE). 'omx' means the source is already OMX -- e.g. importing a calibration run whose raw output was archived pre-converted -- and is trimmed directly with no Voyager dependency; only format 'omx' is valid alongside it.

format.description: Output format for the extracted tables, written as '<stem>.<format>'. Must be 'omx' when source_format is 'omx'.

network.description: Glob pattern matching a Cube Voyager .net network file.

fields.description: Link attribute field names to keep from the matched .net file (plus geometry, for shp/geojson formats). Requires Voyager to be available at curation time.

format.description: Output format for the field-filtered network, written as '<stem>.<format>' ('shp' zipped as '<stem>.shp.zip').

manual_scenario_folder.description: Path to this run's raw output folder, relative to the TDM submodule root, when it was run manually outside `run`/`run-all`. Read by import-manual-run(-all) to locate outputs to curate; unused by a CLI-driven run.
